svg.data-fabric-capacity: 64x 800G cell-switched fabric ports; clusters scale to 921.6 Tbps of routing capacity with S9700-series line-card boxes
svg.data-ac-derate: HIG Connecting Power, AC Version: on a 110V source each PSU provides 1500 W for a total of 3000 W, and the vendor notes that in that case a single PSU failure leaves output insufficient to sustain the router
svg.data-memory: 32 GB DDR4 (2x 16 GB DDR4 R-DIMM with ECC)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 800GE QSFP-DD SR8/LR8/DR4/FR4 and 400GE QSFP-DD SR8; 800GE and 400GE QSFP-DD DAC, AEC and AOC cable assemblies (datasheet Compatible Fabric Transceiver Types and Compatible Fabric Cable Types). Link length up to 300 m (HIG Port Overview)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ on the two management uplinks; the datasheet's compatible optics list covers only the fabric field and names nothing for these two
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO; SyncE; IEEE 1588v2 (default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2); SMPTE ST 2059-2 (extra licence); T-BC/OC, T-TC. NOS integration is required to activate any of them
svg.data-cell-switching: cell-based rather than Ethernet switching, which removes the Ethernet overhead and load-balances every fabric link; three flexibly configured fabric pipes manage upstream connectivity
svg.data-deployment: DDC fabric element - a backplane switch fabric for UfiSpace S9700-series disaggregated open core/edge routers, not a customer-facing router. Keyed `deployment` rather than `role`, which is reserved for the structural role each GROUP carries
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 and micro-USB, both labelled IOIOI
svg.data-uplinks: 2x 10G SFP+ management ports, numbered 0 and 1 outside the fabric range
svg.data-timing-inputs: 1x 1PPS in/out SMB and 1x 10MHz in/out SMB, both Premium build only
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; VCCI CISPR 32 Class A; AS/NZS CISPR 32 Class A
svg.data-nebs: NEBS statements only - the HIG prints a section headed "Cautions and regulatory compliance statements for NEBS" and the datasheet claims no NEBS level, so none is claimed here
svg.data-preliminary: datasheet footer: "Specifications in this document are preliminary and subject to change without notice"
